subject: Action plan: security acceptance runway & data disposition annex
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Matthew Choi <matthew.choi@elarabank.com>, procurement@elarabank.com
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Action plan: security acceptance runway & data disposition annex

Hi Matt / Elara procurement team,

Thanks for the time yesterday — attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that focuses on the security/compliance gates we discussed: SOC 2 Type II timeline, SIG/CAIQ mapping, DPA redline points, and the data retention/disposition annex. The workbook has three sheets: MAP timeline, SIG mapping (high-priority questions only), and a proposed data retention table.

Key asks for your team:
- Confirm which SIG questions you need answered in full vs. summary (we flagged 12 as high priority).
- Confirm target acceptance date for security gates (we put a placeholder of 2026-10-15).
- Share any procurement timeline or cutover blackout dates.

I've looped in Jasmine (solutions engineer) for the SIG mapping and Neha (compliance) for the SOC 2 / DPA specifics. Next step from us: Neha will send a short response that clarifies SOC 2 evidence windows and proposed DPA redline positions; Jasmine will annotate the SIG sheet with execution notes.

Attachment: MAP_Elara_2026_v1.xlsx (workbook, 3 sheets)

Would you be available for a 30-minute alignment call next week to lock the acceptance runway? Proposed times: Tue 2026-09-07 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 2026-09-08 14:00-14:30 PT.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP_Elara_2026_v1.xlsx]

From: Matthew Choi <matthew.choi@elarabank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, procurement@elarabank.com
Cc: security@elarabank.com
Date: 2026-09-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: security acceptance runway & data disposition annex

Jordan — thanks for the MAP. A few quick notes from the security side:

1) SOC 2: we require either an available Type II report within the last 12 months or an assurance plan that achieves Type II within 90 days of production. Can you confirm Redwood's current timeline and any interim artefacts (SOC 2 readiness reports, control matrices)?

2) SIG/CAIQ: we will need the full questionnaire for vendor security review. For now, flagging these as mandatory: data segregation, KMS integration, incident notification SLAs, and access review cadence. If you can map the 12 flagged questions to deliverables in the MAP, that helps.

3) DPA / Retention: we have a strict data disposition policy for EU-resident customers (30–90 day purge window for test datasets, 365-day max for derived analytics). We will also request data locality and subprocessor lists. If Redwood's DPA redline deviates on retention or residency, please call that out.

We can take a 30m on 09/08 14:00 PT. Please include Legal if there are DPA redlines.

—Matt
Matthew Choi
CISO, ElaraBank
[External attachment: none]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-02T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Action plan: security acceptance runway & data disposition annex

Folks — forwarding Matt's email with the asks. Short timeline: they want either SOC 2 Type II in <12 months or an assurance plan that achieves Type II within 90 days of production; SIG full questionnaire (we flagged 12) and strict EU retention windows.

Can Neha draft the SOC 2 / DPA response and call out where we can accept 365-day retention vs where we need carveouts? Karthik — can you confirm the operational feasibility for a 90-day Type II path for a new customer or suggest an alternative (compensating controls, attestation pack)? Jasmine — please start annotating the SIG sheet for the 4 infra questions Matt listed.

I will schedule 09/08 14:00 PT and include Legal.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Matthew Choi <matthew.choi@elarabank.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com, procurement@elarabank.com
Date: 2026-09-03T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: security acceptance runway & data disposition annex

Hi Matt / team — thanks for the clear ask. Quick responses and proposed attachments below. I'll keep this high-level for the MAP and attach the SOC 2 summary and DPA redlines for Legal to review.

SOC 2 timeline:
- Redwood has a completed SOC 2 Type II audit (controls effective period 2025-11 through 2026-05). We will provide the report and the control narrative. (See attached: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf)
- For customers onboarded after the last report, we offer an interim assurance pack: control evidence snapshots + SOC-ready control matrix. We can commit to delivering the interim pack within 10 business days of contract signature.

SIG/CAIQ:
- Jasmine will push an annotated SIG sheet that maps each flagged question to deliverable/artefact and estimated delivery date. For the four infra items (KMS integration, segregation, incident SLA, access review) we can provide architecture diagrams and the incident runbook excerpt within 5 business days.

DPA & data retention:
- Proposed baseline: 365 days for derived analytics (default), 90 days for data used in PII-sensitive test/training sets unless explicitly requested otherwise.
- For EU-resident customer data: we can provide an option for EU-only residency (regional hosting) subject to capacity; note: regional residency may add 6–8 weeks to provisioning.
- We have a subprocessor list and can provide it under NDA.
- Attached: DPA_Elara_redlines_v2.docx — redline includes a proposed carveout for 90-day purge for test datasets and a clause for per-customer residency requests with timelines.

Next steps suggested for the MAP:
- Update MAP timeline: include delivery milestones for SOC artefacts (T+10 business days), SIG answers (T+5 business days), DPA negotiation window (legal review + 5 business days).
- We will indicate acceptance gates: SOC artefacts received -> SIG mapping complete -> DPA signed -> final signoff window.

I'll join the 09/08 meeting and bring Legal if the DPA redline needs live negotiation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf]
[Attachment: DPA_Elara_redlines_v2.docx]

From: Matthew Choi <matthew.choi@elarabank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@elarabank.com, security@elarabank.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-06T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action plan: security acceptance runway & data disposition annex

Neha / Jordan — this is helpful and a lot clearer. A few follow-ups before the call on 09/08: 

- Please attach the SOC 2 Type II report (I assume redwood_soc2-summary.pdf is the narrative; we need the auditor's report). If you prefer, a secure link + NDA will do.
- On the 90-day purge carveout: we need the exact lifecycle for how test datasets are identified and a written purge workflow (who triggers, verification, audit trail).
- SIG: please prioritize the architecture diagrams for KMS and the incident SLA text; those are blocking for our operations review.

If you can drop the SOC report link and the purge workflow doc into the shared Drive before 09/08 10:00 PT, that will let us run an internal pre-read and bring any final legal points.

Thanks — see you on 09/08 14:00 PT.

—Matt
CISO, ElaraBank
